description: Main executable source code for the AgentField control plane CLI application. It initializes configuration, starts the server, builds UI assets if necessary, and manages runtime behavior including environment variable overrides, server startup, and optional browser opening.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application, creates version info and executes the root CLI command.

methods.name: runServer
methods.description: Main logic for starting the server, loading configuration, building UI if needed, and opening the browser.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration from file, environment variables, and sets defaults.

methods.name: buildUI
methods.description: Builds the UI assets by running npm install and build commands inside the specified UI directory.

methods.name: openBrowser
methods.description: Opens the default web browser to the specified URL based on OS.
